per_requirement.extracted_requirement: All transaction data displayed in the Disputes application must be retrieved from the authoritative transaction store to ensure data freshness and correctness.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall interface with the Statement Database. The Statement Database provides the transaction details to the Disputes System. All transaction details must be obtained from the Statement Database'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Cardmember details displayed must be sourced from the single authoritative member information system so names, addresses, and contact preferences remain consistent.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall interface with the Cardmember Information Database. The Cardmember Information Database provides detailed information with regard to a cardmember. All cardmember detail information must be obtained from the Cardmember Information Database.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application must record and retain an audit log of every user action (who did what and when) covering case creation, edits, notes, correspondence sends, and adjustment requests.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application must maintain a detailed history of every action that a user takes on a dispute case. This ensures a complete audit trail if questions arise later on with regard to a particular dispute case.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The disputes application must not directly change account balances; adjustment requests must be handed off to the billing/posting system and the application must record the resulting outcome.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The Disputes application shall interface with the Cardmember Posting and Billing System. This will allow the Disputes application to request adjustments to cardmember and merchant's accounts. All adjustment requests must be sent to the Cardmember Posting and Billing System.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Access control must enforce role-based permissions and account-scoped visibility so that only authorized roles can initiate disputes or request adjustments and reps can only see cardmembers they are assigned to.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall ensure that only users with the appropriate access level are allowed to initiate dispute requests.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Temporary escalated access must be controllable and auditable; any temporary access grants must be logged with who granted them, duration, and justification.
The system must enforce tenant/merchant data segregation so external users (e.g., merchants) can only see their own disputes and cannot access another merchant's data.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes System must prevent users from accessing any dispute cases that do not belong to their cardholder base.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application must be available during business hours when reps and designated external users are working, with only limited planned early-morning maintenance windows (short nightly windows; longer window on Sundays).
Performance must feel snappy: small screens and searches should be near-instant and common small transitions should complete within approximately five seconds or less under normal conditions.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The maximum wait time for a user navigating from one screen to another within the Disputes application shall be no more than 5 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application must scale to handle peak concurrent load of approximately 350 active users without noticeable degradation in responsiveness.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall support 350 concurrent users without any degradation of performance in the application.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The disputes application must orchestrate integrations to canonical backend systems (transaction store, member info store, posting/billing) so reps do not need to access other systems directly.

per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall comply with the corporate standards for user interface creation for internally and externally used applications.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: External portals/views must present a simplified interface and must not expose internal-only data to merchants or partners.
